findings: Ohio Revised Code §5301.25(A) gives the county-of-premises recording rule for the instrument classes it covers; the article does not represent that rule as a complete title conclusion.

Current §317.08(A)(1), (2), (5), (11) and (25) lists the described deed/conveyance, specified notice/affidavit/order, and lease/memorandum/amendment categories. The public checklist states their record roles without declaring a mineral owner or statutory outcome.
The Ohio Recorders' Association current page says it connects the public with all 88 county recorder offices; the article correctly treats it as a directory rather than a unified deed index.

Erie County Recorder FAQ currently says online indexing and images go back to 1990 with earlier material being added, identifies its county document-search and Both Names input, describes copy requests, and disclaims full title-history searches. The article limits every detail to Erie County.

Ashtabula County Recorder currently identifies its own land-record search and deeds/leases among its records and says staff do not perform title examinations. The public copy does not invent another county's field layout or online coverage.
